title: House Floor Amendment 3 to HB 574/HCS 1 (2021 RS)
operative_text:
(form) [full text] On page 29, line 8, after "the" and before "Thursday," insert "Wednesday,"; and On page 29, line 9, after "Saturday" and before "immediately" insert "during the two (2) weeks".
(a_in_person_id_required_and_documents) not stated
(b_voter_without_id) not stated
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated
(d_proof_of_citizenship_to_register) not stated
(e_signature_or_records_verification) not stated
(context) Page 29 line 8-9 of HB 574/HCS 1 (https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/21RS/HB574/HCS1.pdf, fetched) reads: '(2)[(c)] In-person absentee voting shall be conducted in the county clerk's office ... during normal business hours on the Thursday, Friday, and Saturday immediately preceding the day of a primary or an election.' So the amendment would add Wednesday and 'during the two (2) weeks' (early in-person absentee days).

Sponsors (as printed): Rep. Buddy Wheatley (House)
